# SmartSubs Pro

> AI-powered subtitle plugin for DaVinci Resolve. It transcribes timeline audio locally with OpenAI Whisper and builds animated, word-by-word captions on your own Fusion Text+ template, can auto-translate foreign-language audio to English, and runs on both DaVinci Resolve Studio and the free edition (any version from 18 onward, Windows and macOS). One-time purchase of $39.99, no subscription, with a 30-day money-back guarantee. Support is handled personally by Antonio Pennino, a working video editor.

## Guides
- [How to Add Automatic Subtitles in DaVinci Resolve (Free & Studio)](https://smartsubspro.com/guide/auto-subtitles-davinci-resolve/): the built-in Studio tool, the manual Fusion Text+ method, and the automated route compared.
- [Auto Subtitles on the Free Version of DaVinci Resolve](https://smartsubspro.com/guide/davinci-resolve-free-auto-subtitles/): three ways free users can get automatic subtitles.
- [How to Make Karaoke (Word-by-Word) Captions in DaVinci Resolve](https://smartsubspro.com/guide/karaoke-captions-davinci-resolve/): the TikTok/Reels look, why the native subtitle track cannot do it, and how to build it.
- [How to Translate Subtitles in DaVinci Resolve](https://smartsubspro.com/guide/translate-subtitles-davinci-resolve/): auto-translate foreign audio to English with Whisper, or translate an SRT into any language and re-import.
- [How to Customize Your Subtitle Style (Text+ Templates)](https://smartsubspro.com/guide/customize-subtitle-style-davinci-resolve/): edit the Sub_Simple and Sub_Hook Text+ templates for font, colour, size and animation.
- [How to Install and Activate SmartSubs Pro](https://smartsubspro.com/guide/install-smartsubs-pro-davinci-resolve/): setup on Windows and macOS and license activation.
- [SmartSubs Pro vs the Alternatives](https://smartsubspro.com/guide/smartsubs-pro-vs-alternatives/): an honest comparison with AutoSubs, Magic Subtitles and the native Studio tool, including when not to buy.
